name: BACH_0237_FSIM_blur3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1] and 0% invasive risk support routine tier-1 review despite severity-3 blur.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 2%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong Benign call; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at α=0.10 (90% coverage, CI 76%–98%, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, flag=false [F6]; OOD 100th percentile; blur=3 (AUROC 0.70) | Passes QC despite blur, OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | true | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%) [F5], 3/5 Normal (78%–82% similarity) | Split between Benign and Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.23, contrib -0.73) pushes away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.13, contrib -0.34) supports benign call [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.29, contrib -0.32); 0/20 spot-check is unreliable [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.11, contrib +0.29) slightly offsets benign pull · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful in deletion test (+0.0114 drop, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132); only region 0 has risk (0.001).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 blur and 100th-percentile OOD appearance mask subtle invasion or in situ carcinoma (2%) on frozen section.
- Three of five neighbors are Normal (contrast BACH_0297), or lateral margin (p=0.87, call clear [F7]) hides disease.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: Highest tile risk (0.001) and benign stroma (1.16); confirm no stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Check lateral margin segment (p=0.87 at y=768) and highest pleomorphism score (0.19).
3. **Regions 5, 6**: Verify duct-confined atypia (0.20 in region 6) and lymphocytes (0.52 in region 5).
